text.content:
name: changed
nodes:
  worker:
    type: compute
    os: linux
    resources:
      ram: 1 gib
      cpu: 1
    runtime:
      scheduled_jobs:
      - scheduled_job_id: baseline
        name: Baseline job
      - scheduled_job_id: extra
        name: Extra job
infrastructure:
  worker:
    count: 1
variation_points:
  worker-state:
    kind: alternative
    target:
      kind: structural
      owner: worker
      slot: nodes.presence
    alternatives:
      absent:
        kind: node-presence
        present: false
      baseline:
        kind: node-presence
        present: true
        inventory:
          nodes.runtime.scheduled_jobs:
          - nodes.worker.runtime.scheduled_jobs.baseline
      complete:
        kind: node-presence
        present: true
